text: I feel curious and stimulated by my surroundings. The environment is modern and purposeful, brimming with the promise of innovation. The R+D exhibit captures my attention, encouraging me to reflect on the intersection of research, creativity, and technology. Despite the apparent quiet, there is an underlying buzz of potential discovery. It feels inspiring to be here, as if I am participating, however subtly, in the unfolding narrative of human ingenuity.
